LanguageData.WI.DefaultRadius.Desc: Radius a new work table uses when it has no ingredient source selected. Pre-fills each bench's own fallback slider; changing it here does not alter benches already configured.
LanguageData.WI.StatusSourced: Sources selected: this bench pulls ingredients from the checked locations, map-wide. Each bill's own search radius is ignored.
LanguageData.WI.StatusRadius: No source selected: this bench uses the fallback radius below for every bill, overriding each bill's own search radius.
LanguageData.WI.FallbackRadius: Fallback search radius (used when nothing is selected): {0}
